name: 85083 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85083 (Phoenix) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85083 (Phoenix) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85083 (Phoenix) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 27% of the typical level).
